scenes.title: Use consistent updates across different teams

captions.text: Community paramedicine and mental health response teams can use clear
updates during coordinated outreach.
Search-and-rescue teams can keep support staff informed, security teams
can document post updates, wildland contractors can coordinate crew
activity, and industrial emergency teams can maintain standby accountability.
Fire and EMS departments can apply the same habits.
Select the intended call, record only what you mean, and inspect the
saved note or check-in history before handing over to another team member.
